_meta.title: location_quest -> adventure pack and source kind
_meta.source: ddowiki.com, batched MediaWiki API (prop=revisions|categories) per docs/wiki-evidence/harvest-method.md
_meta.why: The Farming List groups a build's sources so a player can answer 'do I even own this?' first. The dataset has no pack field and gear-planner has none upstream; the only acquisition datum is the free-text `location_quest`. This maps those values.
_meta.never_infer: Every entry records the WIKI SIGNAL that decided it in `via`. A value with no such signal is `unknown` and renders under 'Source unknown' — it is never guessed from the name. 33 of 533 are unknown, and they are mostly public zones, non-locations and crafting ingredients rather than quests.
_meta.pack_semantics: `pack` is the adventure pack, verbatim as the wiki writes it. 'Free to Play' means the wiki states the quest needs no pack. An empty `pack` on a pack-quest means the page is a quest but names no pack and none could be sourced.

via_codes.T: `Adpack` template on the page (the page IS in that pack)
via_codes.B: Quest infobox `adpack` parameter present and EMPTY (no pack required)
via_codes.R: cited as the `adpack` of other harvested quests
via_codes.Q: a quest page stating no pack

_meta.extraction_note: The `adpack` parameter is often present and EMPTY. An earlier pattern used `\s*$`, and because `\s` matches a newline it ran the empty value onto the following line and captured `| level = 8` as three quests' adventure pack. The shipped pattern is line-bounded. All 533 rows were hash-verified against the live wiki before being written here.
_meta.crafting_may_carry_a_pack: #729 — a `crafting` entry MAY carry a pack, and `Catalyst Crafting` is the first. The earlier invariant (only a pack-quest carries a pack) read `location_pack` as 'which quest pack is this quest in'. The #246 content filter consumes it as 'content the player must own', and an expansion-gated crafting system fits that meaning exactly — `kind` already records the source type separately. Keeping the invariant meant no expansion-gated crafting system could ever be excluded, which is the reported bug. Deliberately NOT applied to the other 16 crafting sources: each needs its own prose read, tracked separately.
